components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; height: 58px; background: var(--ground); } .ds-nav a { height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--muted); font: 12px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--ink); border-bottom-color: var(--line); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal-bright); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Camera Index Item
components.description: Selects an inspection camera while separately showing runtime dispatch state.
components.css: .ds-camera-index-item { width: 100%; min-height: 74px; padding: 11px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--steel); background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); display: grid; grid-template-columns: 35px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 9px; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-camera-index-item:hover { background: var(--panel-2); } .ds-camera-index-item.ds-focused { background: var(--panel-2); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 var(--signal-bright); } .ds-camera-index-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal-bright); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-camera-letter { width: 31px; height: 31px; border: 1px solid var(--signal-bright); color: var(--signal-bright); display: grid; place-items: center; font: 600 14px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-camera-copy b, .ds-camera-copy small { display: block; } .ds-camera-copy b { font: 600 12px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-camera-copy small { margin-top: 5px; color: var(--muted); font: 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-camera-flag { color: var(--signal-bright); font: 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

components.css: .ds-measured-feed { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 5.4; overflow: hidden; background: #080b0d; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); color: var(--ink); } .ds-feed-field { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--faint); font: 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-reticle { position: absolute; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-color: #aac1ca88; } .ds-top-left { top: 12px; left: 12px; border-top: 1px solid; border-left: 1px solid; } .ds-top-right { top: 12px; right: 12px; border-top: 1px solid; border-right: 1px solid; } .ds-bottom-left { bottom: 12px; left: 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid; border-left: 1px solid; } .ds-bottom-right { right: 12px; bottom: 12px; border-right: 1px solid; border-bottom: 1px solid; } .ds-coordinate, .ds-tally { position: absolute; top: 10px; padding: 5px 7px; background: #0b1013e8; border: 1px solid #435159; color: #c6d2d6; font: 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .05em; } .ds-coordinate { left: 10px; } .ds-tally { right: 10px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; border-color: var(--signal); color: var(--signal-bright); } .ds-tally i { width: 7px; height: 7px; background: var(--signal-bright); }

components.name: Take Control Button
components.description: Acquires a five-minute protected dispatch override when the runtime is connected.
components.css: .ds-control-button { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--signal); border-radius: 0; background: #17242a; color: var(--signal-bright); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font: 600 11px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-control-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #203139; } .ds-control-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal-bright); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-control-button:disabled { opacity: .42; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Release Override Button
components.description: Releases an active protected override with a cautionary, non-destructive visual distinction.
components.css: .ds-release-button { height: 34px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 0; background: #282018; color: #d2a66f; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font: 600 11px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-release-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #203139; } .ds-release-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal-bright); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-release-button:disabled { opacity: .42; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Operational State Mark
components.description: A square marker plus explicit label for live, warning, error, and neutral states.
components.css: .ds-state-mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--muted); font: 500 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-state-mark i { width: 7px; height: 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-state-mark.ds-good { color: var(--good); } .ds-state-mark.ds-good i { background: var(--good); } .ds-state-mark.ds-warn { color: var(--amber); } .ds-state-mark.ds-warn i { background: var(--amber); } .ds-state-mark.ds-bad { color: var(--red); } .ds-state-mark.ds-bad i { background: var(--red); }

components.css: .ds-instrument { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0; background: var(--panel); color: var(--ink); } .ds-instrument-label { color: var(--signal-bright); font: 600 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-route { margin-top: 14px; display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--signal-bright); } .ds-route span { border: 1px solid var(--signal); padding: 7px 8px; font: 600 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-route i { height: 1px; flex: 1; background: var(--signal); } .ds-instrument > strong { display: block; margin: 11px 0; font: 600 11px/1.45 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-instrument dl { margin: 0; } .ds-instrument dl div { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 7px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--steel); font: 11px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-instrument dt { color: var(--muted); } .ds-instrument dd { margin: 0; font-family: 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

components.name: Selected Candidate Row
components.description: A policy-first candidate record that moves camera inspection focus.
components.css: .ds-candidate-row { width: 100%; min-height: 47px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--steel); background: var(--panel); color: #c6ced1; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 55px 1.1fr .65fr .85fr; align-items: center; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-candidate-row > span { min-width: 0; padding: 8px 10px; font: 10px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-candidate-row small, .ds-candidate-row b { display: block; } .ds-candidate-row small { margin-bottom: 4px; color: var(--faint); font-size: 8px; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-candidate-row:hover { background: var(--panel-2); } .ds-candidate-row.ds-selected { background: #162229; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 var(--signal-bright); } .ds-candidate-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--signal-bright); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Current Decision Sequence Item
components.description: The newest retained scheduling decision in the horizontal evidence sequence.
components.css: .ds-decision-current { min-width: 190px; padding: 11px; border-right: 1px solid var(--steel); background: #162229; color: var(--ink); } .ds-decision-time { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; color: var(--faint); font: 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-decision-time i { height: 1px; flex: 1; background: var(--signal); } .ds-decision-current > strong, .ds-decision-current > span, .ds-decision-current > small, .ds-decision-current > code { display: block; } .ds-decision-current > strong { margin-top: 12px; font: 600 13px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-decision-current > span { margin-top: 3px; font: 10px 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-decision-current > small { min-height: 27px; margin-top: 8px; color: var(--muted); font: 11px/1.45 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; text-transform: lowercase; } .ds-decision-current > code { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--faint); font: 11px 'Cascadia Mono', Consolas, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
CAHMA Control is built as a measured industrial instrument, not a generic dashboard. Anodized graphite planes, steel rules, engraved labels, desaturated camera fields, tabular readings, and sparse signal colors make policy-governed allocation visible as a physical-feeling operating bench. The surface is dense but ordered: the live mechanism is dominant, while every surrounding panel explains what the runtime admitted, selected, inferred, or retained.

The composition tells one continuous story: choose a camera in the index, inspect its measured feed, read the fixed dispatch and capacity rail, compare the camera array, scan the ranked candidate field, then follow the retained decision sequence into policy and evidence. Runtime absence is never cosmetically repaired. Unconfirmed fixtures, empty readings, stale events, rejected capacity, and disabled controls remain visibly distinct from healthy operation.
keyCharacteristics: Planar graphite surfaces separated by steel rules, never floating cards.
Square instrument geometry with right-angle reticles, meters, cells, and state marks.
Measured video as the visual center, with coordinates, detections, tally, and numeric strips attached to the frame.
A narrow camera index and fixed instrumentation rail that keep selection, dispatch, capacity, and policy in view.
Cyan-steel for focus and inference, with muted green, amber, and red reserved for semantic state.
Compact system typography and tabular data that stay legible in a projected laptop demo.

rules.name: The Signal Economy Rule
rules.body: Calibration cyan marks focus, selection, route, or active inference; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Redundant State Rule
rules.body: Operational state always has a text label, symbol, border, or placement cue in addition to color.

rules.name: The No Spectacle Color Rule
rules.body: Gradients, neon, rainbow accents, pastel surfaces, and decorative color effects are forbidden.

rules.name: The Instrument Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase mono labels identify equipment and state; sentence-case sans text explains meaning.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: Type supports the operating surface; no oversized marketing headline may displace live mechanism or evidence.

rules.name: The Mechanism-First Rule
rules.body: Camera selection, measured feed, dispatch, capacity, candidate ordering, and operator control must remain ahead of policy explanation and historical evidence.

rules.name: The Planar Bench Rule
rules.body: Do not add ambient shadows, glow, blur, glass, or lifted-card depth; use rules and tonal planes.

rules.name: The Inset State Rule
rules.body: A two-pixel cyan inset edge may mark the current camera, candidate, or compact feed, but it never becomes a decorative shadow vocabulary.

dos: Do preserve the Optical Metrology Bench sequence: camera index, measured feed, dispatch/capacity rail, camera array, candidate field, decision sequence, policy, then evidence.
Do use square geometry, one-pixel steel rules, compact mono readings, and desaturated measured video as the durable instrument language.
Do distinguish focused inspection, selected dispatch, active inference, eligibility, connection phase, fixture use, stale data, capacity rejection, and unavailable data with explicit language.
Do keep keyboard focus visible with the two-pixel cyan outline and three-pixel offset on every interactive anchor and button.
Do preserve the truthful empty and unconfirmed states and the inspect-only camera-policy boundary.
Do treat the Bahnschrift, Segoe UI, Cascadia Mono, and Consolas stacks as system-dependent until an approved bundled-font strategy exists.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, rainbow or neon color, pastel palettes, radial orbs, dot-grid backgrounds, sparkles, emojis, or generic AI decoration.
Don't use liquid glass, backdrop blur, ambient glow, large shadows, lifted cards, bento grids, or excessive rounded containers.
Don't turn the interface into a terminal window, marketing page, fake demo, pricing surface, testimonial wall, social-proof module, or checklist pitch.
Don't add excessive pills, decorative arrows, oversized type, excessive hover motion, or ornamental animation.
Don't invent healthy runtime values, hide unavailable states, imply policy mutation, or overstate detector and learned-SAGE evidence.
Don't install or substitute a hosted display font without resolving the current denied self-hosting constraint and verifying projected-laptop metrics.
